name: Fact assertions against source documents
description: Extract each factual assertion in the brief that carries a date, quantity or party action, and compare it with the cited (or best-matching) source document at page and line.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.description: All non-authority documents in the project

name: Quotation check against cited authorities
description: For each quoted passage attributed to an authority, compare it character by character with the authority text in the project and show the difference.

name: Contrary-authority search (model judgment)
description: A model reads the argument and the project's authority set and lists authorities that cut against it. Output is a model judgment, never a deterministic result.

acceptanceRule.description: Informational: surfaces candidates for the lawyer to assess

name: Systematic date-assertion sweep (proposed experiment, protocol v1)
description: Enumerate every date in the brief and match each against every dated document location in the project; report supported, unsupported and ambiguous dates. Runs only under an approved protocol.

name: Privilege review of imported correspondence
description: Tag privileged material and restrict access before analysis.

acceptanceRule.description: Every privileged document tagged before it is analysed

unsupportedReason: Document-handling controls (privilege tagging, redaction, access logging) are integration pending. Path: the firm's document-management system performs privilege review; results are imported as a document attribute.
